research.orbitalis.node.aluminum_lithium: Lighter and stiffer: every kilogram saved adds delta-v.
research.orbitalis.node.aluminum_structu: Light tanks and hulls made of aluminum plates.
research.orbitalis.node.capsules.desc: First crewed flights, like Vostok and Mercury.
research.orbitalis.node.closed_loop_life: Air and water recycling for long stays.
research.orbitalis.node.communication_sa: Long-range communication and relays for probes.
research.orbitalis.node.cryobot.desc: A probe that melts the ice to go down to a hidden ocean. Unlocks the cryobot, to look for life under Europa's ice.
research.orbitalis.node.europa_lander.de: Land on Europa, under Jupiter's radiation, and leave again. Also unlocks the suit's radiation shielding.
A sphere and a radio transmitter: the space age begins, as with Sputnik.
research.orbitalis.node.flight_computers: Automatic guidance, from ignition to orbit insertion.
research.orbitalis.node.fuel_cells.desc: Electricity and water from hydrogen and oxygen, as on Gemini and Apollo. Essential for long missions: it opens orbital rendezvous.
research.orbitalis.node.fuel_farm.desc: Propellant storage and lines to the launch pad. Lets you place fuel ports.
research.orbitalis.node.fusion.desc: The power of stars, to cross the solar system. Unlocks the fusion drive, which burns helium-3 from the Moon, and the fusion reactor, which turns it into electricity.
research.orbitalis.node.gyroscopes.desc: They measure the rocket's attitude and keep it on course.
research.orbitalis.node.heat_shields.des: Tiles and ablative shields to survive atmospheric reentry.
research.orbitalis.node.helium3.desc: Bake the Moon's regolith to free the solar wind's helium-3, the fuel of fusion. Unlocks the helium-3 extractor.
research.orbitalis.node.hydrolox_engines: The best chemical efficiency, like Vulcain or RS-25. Ideal for upper stages.
research.orbitalis.node.hypergolics.desc: Hydrazine and its relatives ignite on contact. Unlocks the hypergolic engine, loaded at the factory: no fuelling at the pad.
research.orbitalis.node.ion_propulsion.d: Tiny thrust but huge efficiency, using xenon. Unlocks the ion thruster, an upper stage for probes and satellites: once in orbit, it adds thousands of m/s of delta-v.
research.orbitalis.node.isru.desc: Make water, oxygen and fuel from local resources. Unlocks the ice drill (Moon, Mars) and the oxygen extractor (Mars).
Turbopump engines burning kerosene and liquid oxygen, like Merlin, F-1 or RD-180.
research.orbitalis.node.landers.desc: Land softly on another celestial body. Unlocks the robotic landers, which really touch down on the Moon or Mars.
research.orbitalis.node.launch_escape.de: A tower pulls the capsule away from a failing rocket. Without it, the crew is hurt when their rocket breaks up.
research.orbitalis.node.launch_pad.desc: Launch table and flame trench for the first rockets.
research.orbitalis.node.life_support.des: Oxygen, pressure and temperature: what it takes to keep a crew alive.
research.orbitalis.node.lunar_gateway.de: An outpost around the Moon, like the Lunar Gateway. Unlocks the lunar gateway, launched like a satellite, which earns points every day from lunar orbit.
research.orbitalis.node.lunar_lander.des: Land on the Moon and take off again, like the Apollo lunar module.
research.orbitalis.node.mars_lander.desc: Land on Mars by hand, on its engine, and leave again.
research.orbitalis.node.methalox_engines: Reusable full-flow engines, like Raptor or BE-4. Unlocks the methalox engine and the Sabatier reactor, which makes methane from coal and hydrogen.
Telemetry screens and trajectory tracking during the mission. Lets you place mission displays.
research.orbitalis.node.mission_tablet.d: The atlas in your hand, wherever a communication satellite relays the data.
research.orbitalis.node.navigation_satel: A medium-orbit constellation gives your position anywhere.
A reactor heats hydrogen, like NERVA. Unlocks the nuclear thermal engine, twice as efficient as a chemical engine but heavy and hungry for tanks. It's only for upper stages. Also unlocks the hydrogen tank, big and light, made for it.
research.orbitalis.node.orbital_shipyard: Building in orbit what no rocket could ever launch: a ship for other stars. Unlocks the shipyard module.
Habitats, power plants and greenhouses for a lasting presence. Unlocks the planetary base kit, which builds a pressurised module on the Moon or Mars.
research.orbitalis.node.pressure_fed_eng: First liquid engines, fed by tank pressure.
research.orbitalis.node.probes.desc: They fly past other worlds and send data back. Unlocks the lunar and Mars probes, which map the body from orbit.
research.orbitalis.node.rendezvous_docki: Two spacecraft meet in orbit, as in the Gemini program.
research.orbitalis.node.robotic_arm.desc: It grabs cargo as it arrives, like Canadarm2: what a launcher delivers to the station is stowed in a cargo rack.
research.orbitalis.node.rotorcraft.desc: Rotor drones, like Ingenuity on Mars and Dragonfly on Titan. Unlocks the rotor drone, which flies off alone to study nearby sites.
research.orbitalis.node.rovers.desc: Exploration vehicles, like the LRV, Curiosity or Perseverance. Unlocks the rover, a solar-powered lunar buggy you set down and drive.
research.orbitalis.node.rtg.desc: A power source for decades, far from the Sun: satellites launched afterwards last twice as long.
research.orbitalis.node.sample_return.de: Bring rocks back to Earth for research. Unlocks robotic sample return missions and the sample container, to take samples yourself.
research.orbitalis.node.service_tower.de: Umbilical arms, access to the rocket and hold-down clamps.
research.orbitalis.node.solar_arrays.des: Truss, Sun-tracking solar arrays and radiators.
research.orbitalis.node.solar_power.desc: Electrical power in orbit, as long as the Sun is in view. Lets you place solar panels.
research.orbitalis.node.solar_sails.desc: Sunlight pushes a huge sail, with no fuel. Unlocks the solar sail, an upper stage with no propellant, all the better as the payload is light.
research.orbitalis.node.solid_boosters.d: Large strap-on boosters, as on Ariane 5 or the Space Shuttle. Unlocks the solid booster.
research.orbitalis.node.solid_motors.des: Solid propellant: simple and reliable, but it cannot be shut down. The engine of sounding rockets.
research.orbitalis.node.sounding_payload: Instruments that measure the upper atmosphere during a suborbital flight.
research.orbitalis.node.space_telescopes: They discover new worlds and unlock destinations.
research.orbitalis.node.spacesuits.desc: Suits for launch and for spacewalks.
research.orbitalis.node.staged_combustio: All propellant goes through the main chamber: more thrust and efficiency.
Cheap and strong at both very low and very high temperatures, as on Starship. Unlocks the large stainless tank.
Habitation modules, laboratories and connecting nodes.
research.orbitalis.node.steelmaking.desc: Steel, made in the arc foundry. Known from the start.
research.orbitalis.node.superalloys.desc: Inconel-type alloys that withstand combustion chamber heat. Unlocks the vacuum engine, for upper stages.
research.orbitalis.node.telemetry.desc: The rocket sends its measurements to the ground during flight: every flight that reaches space earns 3 more points.
research.orbitalis.node.test_stands.desc: Engine tests earn research points: each engine studied at the engineer workbench gives 15.
research.orbitalis.node.titan_lander.des: Land on Titan under parachutes, like the Huygens probe, and leave again.
research.orbitalis.node.titanium_parts.d: Strong and light, for the most heavily loaded parts. Unlocks the titanium tank, the lightest.
research.orbitalis.node.tracking_station: Large antennas to stay in touch with distant spacecraft. Opens the tracking station's observatory and survey.
research.orbitalis.node.vehicle_assembly: Large launchers are assembled indoors, then rolled out to the pad. Allows three-stage launchers.
research.orbitalis.node.warp_drive.desc: Folding space to reach other stars. Unlocks the warp core, charged with exotic matter, which the Casimir chamber draws from the vacuum.

sequence.orbitalis.poll.refused: A station said no-go. Fix it, then run the poll again.
sequence.orbitalis.pressure_lost: Tank pressure has dropped: part of the cold propellants went with it.
sequence.orbitalis.scorched: Without the deluge, the flames broke the deck. Slabs lost: %s.
sequence.orbitalis.step.chill.desc: Chills the turbopump engines with cryogenic propellant. The chill-down only holds for two minutes.
sequence.orbitalis.step.cutoff.desc: Shuts the engines down at the right speed: too early or too late and the orbit is missed.
sequence.orbitalis.step.deluge.desc: Floods the base of the pad to soak up the noise and heat of liftoff.
sequence.orbitalis.step.fairing.desc: Jettisons the fairing once out of the atmosphere: the payload no longer needs it.
sequence.orbitalis.step.ignite.desc: Lights the engines. Thrust builds over three seconds while the clamps hold the rocket down.
sequence.orbitalis.step.internal.desc: Switches the rocket to its own batteries: it leaves ground power before liftoff.
sequence.orbitalis.step.poll.desc: Asks every mission control station before ignition, to find out what isn't ready.
sequence.orbitalis.step.pressurize.desc: Pressurizes the tanks to feed the engines. It only holds for two minutes, so ignite before then.
sequence.orbitalis.step.release.desc: Releases the clamps once thrust reaches 100%: liftoff.
sequence.orbitalis.step.retract.desc: Swings the umbilical arm and the gangway away from the rocket. Do it before ignition.
sequence.orbitalis.step.stage.desc: Drops the empty stage and lights the next one, inside the shown window.
sequence.orbitalis.step.test_alarm.desc: Sounds the pad alarm: sirens and beacons.
sequence.orbitalis.step.test_arms.desc: Swings the tower arms to check that they clear the rocket.
sequence.orbitalis.step.test_deluge.desc: Opens the deluge to watch the water flow, with no rocket and no countdown.
sequence.orbitalis.step.throttle.desc: Throttles down through max-Q to spare the structure.
sequence.orbitalis.step.valves.desc: Opens the valves to fuel up from the pad. Close them at 100%, or the pressure climbs too high.
sequence.orbitalis.test.arm_away: The arm is already retracted: put it back before the test.
sequence.orbitalis.test.no_pad: The launch pad is not in service: no test possible.
sequence.orbitalis.test.valves: Close the valves before swinging the arm away.
